Completing the look is a flexible natural gum rubber outsole in the Gum4 shade, featuring a slightly translucent, caramel-brown finish that further enhances the nostalgic aesthetic. Whether paired with jeans, chinos, or relaxed casual outfits, this adidas sneaker offers versatile styling possibilities while combining classic indoor sports heritage with contemporary everyday appeal. Its thoughtful combination of material texture, contrasting colors, and traditional design elements makes it a stylish companion for a wide variety of occasions.

products.title: Gallery Shoe
products.body_html:
The Crocs Gallery Shoe combines Crocs’ experimental design language with a distinctive low-top silhouette that offers a modern interpretation of classic moccasin and boat-shoe elements. One of its defining features is the textured, textile-like upper with a rough, mottled surface that gives the model an individual character. The Black Sand colorway combines a dark, warm grey with subtle brown and taupe nuances. Its irregular texture creates varying shades across the upper, while the deep black sole unit provides a clear contrast. Tonal laces, black eyelets and the dark-trimmed collar consistently continue the understated color palette. A raised, textured protective section wraps around the lower part of the shoe and transitions seamlessly into the voluminous outsole. Openings along the lateral toe area visually break up the substantial construction while supporting ventilation. Pronounced outsole tread emphasizes the rugged appearance and provides a grippy foundation. The Crocs Gallery Shoe combines functional Crocs DNA with progressive footwear design and a versatile, earthy color palette.

• Color: Black Sand

• Textured, mottled upper in grey, brown and taupe shades

• Low-top design with lacing and lateral ventilation openings

• Voluminous black sole construction with distinctive tread

• Article number: 210640-0LD

products.title: Samba OG
products.body_html:
As an iconic redesign of a timeless classic, the adidas Samba OG presents itself in a particularly stylish, earthy color composition for the sophisticated and style-conscious wardrobe. The intricately textured upper material impresses with a finely woven textile pattern in the nuanced Blanch Brown shade, giving the sporty model a tactilely fascinating and distinctly refined aesthetic. High-quality overlays made of supple suede in the Khaki Three hue frame the signature T-toe cap as well as the eyestay most elegantly, while the iconic 3-Stripes in bright Silver Pebble set a wonderfully harmonious visual contrast along the side panels. The classic low-profile silhouette is completed by a tonal, extremely durable rubber outsole that not only perfectly underscores the authentic retro look, but also delivers reliable grip and excellent stability on all paved city surfaces. Thanks to its regular fit and traditional lacing system, this versatile shoe offers an excellent, anatomical fit alongside first-class wearing comfort from morning to night. Whether stylishly paired with relaxed denim, modern trousers, or casual weekend outfits – this legendary classic unites sporting heritage with contemporary elegance for confident appearances on every conceivable occasion.

• Finely woven textile upper with refined structure in Blanch Brown

• Premium suede overlays in Khaki Three on the toe cap and eyestay

• Iconic 3-Stripes in bright Silver Pebble for a harmonious color contrast

• Durable rubber outsole with low-profile design for optimal grip

• Item number: KK2371

products.title: Terrex Freehiker SL GTX
products.body_html:
Engineered for demanding exploration and weatherproof adventures, the adidas Terrex Freehiker SL GTX presents itself as a reliable hiking shoe in a powerful, functional aesthetic. The monochromatic design is defined by deep Core Black on the durable upper, which is stylishly complemented by extremely robust synthetic reinforcements in dark Grey Six. Along the sides, the signature 3-Stripes and understated branding details in color-coordinated Grey Six set discreetly athletic accents, while a small orange Continental logo on the heel offers a subtle color contrast. Equipped with a waterproof GORE-TEX membrane, your feet remain reliably dry and comfortably ventilated even during sudden rain showers or on wet trails. The innovative Dreamstrike midsole delivers outstanding cushioning properties and noticeable comfort across any surface, while the convenient speed lacing system allows for effortless adjustments. At the same time, the grippy Continental rubber outsole with its pronounced lug pattern provides uncompromising traction and maximum stability on muddy paths as well as paved roads. Whether on intense nature hikes, spontaneous treks, or extensive city explorations – this functional outdoor shoe perfectly combines premium weather protection and performance.

• Waterproof and breathable GORE-TEX membrane for optimal weather protection

• Cushioning Dreamstrike midsole for high walking comfort across varied terrain

• Convenient speed lacing system delivering customizable fit and easy adjustment

• Lugged Continental rubber outsole for top-tier grip and maximum stability

• Item number: KJ4430

products.title: Samba OG Mule
products.body_html:
The adidas Samba OG Mule completely reimagines a timeless icon of sports history in a breezy, summer-ready way. The upper arrives in a warm cream white, featuring an intricately woven leather pattern across the midfoot and toe box that provides refined texture alongside optimal ventilation on warm days. Soft suede overlays at the T-toe and eyestay complement the light palette seamlessly, while the signature three stripes line the sides with subtle detail. Elevating the elegant design are shimmering accents in Gold Metallic, including the cursive Samba lettering on the quarter as well as the iconic adidas Trefoil logo printed on the tongue and footbed. Designed with a backless heel for effortless slip-on wear, this pair lends a relaxed, contemporary edge to the classic outline. Completing the construction is a traditional translucent rubber outsole in a natural gum shade, delivering solid grip while honoring the heritage of the original model. This sophisticated mule blends athletic tradition with modern comfort and an eye-catching aesthetic for warm weather.

• Summer-ready slip-on silhouette with an open heel for effortless wear

• Cream white leather and suede upper featuring an airy woven lattice design

• Shimmering logo detailing and Samba lettering in metallic gold

• Classic semi-translucent gum rubber outsole providing reliable grip

• Item number: KH7719

products.title: Samba Bowling
products.body_html:
The adidas Samba Bowling gives the timeless sports silhouette a sophisticated, bowling-inspired makeover packed with premium details. Its high-quality upper features supple leather in deep Preloved Brown, enhanced by subtle Shadow Brown hand-finished burnishing that lends rich visual depth and a vintage patina. Creating a bold accent, the signature 3-Stripes and matching heel tab are crafted from glossy Core Black leather. The refined look is elevated by metallic gold branding, including the classic Samba lettering along the lateral side and the iconic adidas Trefoil mark on the tongue. Inside, a smooth leather lining ensures superior step-in comfort and a premium feel all day long. Departed from the traditional rubber cupsole, this special edition adopts a flat outsole design with a low heel profile and dark sole frame, perfectly capturing the aesthetic of vintage bowling footwear. The signature T-toe design and tonal welt stitching complete the elevated composition of this unique release. This model seamlessly bridges athletic heritage with refined shoemaking craftsmanship for an extraordinary impression.

• Premium leather upper in rich Preloved Brown with subtle Shadow Brown burnished accents

• Iconic 3-Stripes and heel tab in contrasting glossy Core Black leather

• Metallic gold branding featuring the classic Samba side inscription and tongue logo

• Vintage bowling shoe outsole design with a low heel profile and dark bottom frame

• Item number: HP5198

products.title: Megaride Bones
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Megaride Bones reinterprets the futuristic Megaride silhouette with an almost entirely black appearance and an exceptionally enclosed construction. The Core Black upper features a smooth, leather-like surface that extends almost seamlessly from the high instep to the toe area. Organically shaped black elements wrap around the sides of the shoe, giving it a sculptural, technically inspired structure. One particularly striking feature is the concealed lacing: instead of traditional exposed laces, a cover extending across the instep creates a clean, flowing shape. The padded opening and textile sections inside continue the deep black color scheme and reinforce the monochromatic overall appearance. Beneath the upper, the voluminous Megaride sole with its characteristic open cushioning elements creates a distinctive finish. Subtle Better Scarlet details appear within the sole construction, providing a carefully placed red contrast against Core Black. With its dynamic lines, pronounced proportions and experimental construction, the Willy Chavarria x adidas Megaride Bones combines the design language of the collaboration with characteristic adidas performance influences.

• Collaboration between Willy Chavarria and adidas

• Core Black with carefully placed Better Scarlet accents

• Enclosed upper with concealed lacing

• Voluminous Megaride sole with open cushioning elements

• Article number: KJ2033

products.title: Megaride Wolf
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Megaride Wolf combines sculptural design language with technical running influences and the distinctive aesthetic of the collaboration. The upper is predominantly presented in deep Core Black, combining breathable mesh sections with large, flowing overlays. Organically shaped cut-outs along the sides create additional depth and give the voluminous silhouette its futuristic character. Different shades of black and dark anthracite provide subtle contrasts without interrupting the almost monochromatic appearance. Beneath the upper, the distinctive Megaride construction continues with open, segmented cushioning elements, emphasizing the technical direction of this adidas sneaker. Better Scarlet is deliberately understated: the rich dark red shade is visible within selected sections of the sole and also appears on the Willy Chavarria lettering on the insole. Black laces, a padded tongue, and a softly lined collar complement the powerful overall look. The result is an exceptional Willy Chavarria x adidas shoe that combines experimental proportions, functionally inspired details, and a consistently dark color palette to create a distinctive design.

• Collaboration between Willy Chavarria and adidas

• Core Black with dark anthracite shades and Better Scarlet details

• Mesh upper with sculpturally shaped overlays

• Segmented Megaride sole with open cushioning elements

• Article number: KJ2034

products.title: Megaride Bones
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Megaride Bones combines a bold, futuristic shape with the distinctive design aesthetic of the collaboration between Willy Chavarria and adidas. The Halo Green, Silver Metallic and Better Scarlet colorway is particularly striking: light, slightly pastel Halo Green covers large areas of the upper and gives the shoe a fresh, contemporary appearance, while glossy Silver Metallic details add technical accents and emphasize its dynamic lines. Better Scarlet completes the color scheme with vibrant red contrasts that create visual tension and add extra depth to the overall design. The characteristic Megaride silhouette immediately stands out with its voluminous construction and visible, technically inspired sole structure. Organic-looking elements meet precisely executed details, creating a distinctive appearance that blends progressive adidas design with Willy Chavarria’s expressive signature. With its combination of bold proportions, layered color composition and sports-inspired aesthetics, the Willy Chavarria x adidas Megaride Bones presents itself as an exceptional model for contemporary outfits and carefully curated sneaker rotations.

• Collaboration between Willy Chavarria and adidas

• Colorway: Halo Green / Silver Metallic / Better Scarlet

• Technically inspired, voluminous sole construction

products.title: Dark Rose Tee
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Dark Rose Tee combines a minimal front with an expressive back design, precisely showcasing the unmistakable aesthetic of this collaboration. Deep black forms the base of the T-shirt and creates a strong contrast with the intense red graphics. On the chest, a compact combination of the adidas Trefoil, Chavarria lettering, and “Fine Athletic Fashions” detail adds a focused color accent without overpowering the minimalist character of the front. The back, by contrast, takes a much bolder approach: a large red rose dominates the upper section and is complemented by prominent Chavarria lettering and typography positioned underneath. Different shades of red within the rose graphic create additional depth against the black background and give the Dark Rose design a particularly striking presence. Wide short sleeves, dropped shoulders, and the generous silhouette give the Willy Chavarria x adidas T-shirt a relaxed, contemporary shape. A classic crew neck completes the design with understated simplicity. Thanks to its Black and Red combination, this graphic tee pairs easily with denim, wide-leg trousers, or adidas track pants while adding a distinctive visual accent.

• Black T-shirt with intense red graphic details

• Small Chavarria and adidas graphic on the front

• Large red rose motif with Chavarria lettering on the back

• Relaxed silhouette with dropped shoulders and wide sleeves

• Product number: KZ3115

products.title: Woven Track Jacket
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Woven Track Jacket combines classic sportswear influences with the designer’s expressive aesthetic, placing a strong focus on contrasting details. Black defines the entire body, high stand-up collar, and elasticated trims, creating a distinctive and versatile foundation. The signature adidas 3-Stripes run along the sleeves in a dark red tone that stands out clearly against the deep black base. On the front, a white embroidered rose and two white Trefoil logos complement the understated design. The back delivers the most striking detail: an oversized red rose graphic is combined with Chavarria lettering and “Fine Athletic Fashions,” giving the black track jacket a distinctive appearance. Raglan sleeves enhance the athletic silhouette, while the full-length front zipper and side pockets complete the functional character of the Woven Track Jacket. Through the combination of a black base, red accents, and white embroidered details, the Willy Chavarria x adidas jacket creates a strong visual contrast while bringing together adidas heritage and a distinctive designer signature.

• Willy Chavarria x adidas collaboration

• Black base with dark red 3-Stripes

• White rose embroidery and Trefoil logos on the chest

• Oversized red Chavarria rose graphic on the back

products.title: Dazzle Longsleeves Jersey
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Dazzle Longsleeves Jersey in Black combines a football-inspired aesthetic with Willy Chavarria’s distinctive design language. Deep black defines the jersey’s base color, creating a high-contrast backdrop for the vivid red details. On the front, the signature adidas 3-Stripes run diagonally across the shoulder areas, while additional red stripes accent the forearms. Two vertically positioned Trefoil logos create another focal point at the center of the chest. The large Chavarria lettering in red Gothic typography is particularly striking, giving the black adidas long-sleeve jersey an unmistakable appearance. The back remains deliberately understated and is complemented by a delicate red rose graphic near the upper section. A V-neck and the visually layered sleeve construction reinforce the characteristic jersey look. Black cuffs harmoniously continue the dark base and create a clean finish at the sleeves. Through the combination of rich black, intense red, and prominent branding elements, the Willy Chavarria x adidas Jersey delivers an expressive design that blends sportswear references with a modern, fashion-focused silhouette.

• Black long-sleeve jersey with contrasting red details

• adidas 3-Stripes, Trefoil logos and Chavarria lettering on the front

• Red rose graphic on the upper back

• V-neck and visually layered long-sleeve construction

products.title: Atelier Tee
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Atelier Tee combines striking graphic details with a deliberately generous silhouette, clearly showcasing the distinctive aesthetic of the collaboration. A deep, almost saturated black serves as the base, giving the shirt a powerful, understated appearance while creating a strong contrast with the vivid red design elements. On the front, a small red Willy Chavarria Atelier de Comunidad branding detail on the chest provides a precise accent. The back is dominated by a large-scale red graphic featuring an eagle and a snake. The design is complemented by the adidas Trefoil, Willy Chavarria lettering, and “Atelier de Comunidad” typography. The wide-cut body, dropped shoulders, and generously proportioned short sleeves define the relaxed oversized look of this black T-shirt. Through the combination of a dark base color, intense red accents, and an eye-catching back print, the Willy Chavarria x adidas T-shirt develops a distinctive character. The classic crew neckline keeps the front intentionally clean, while the expressive back graphic creates the visual focus and effectively highlights the shared design language of adidas and Willy Chavarria.

products.title: Woven Track Pant
products.body_html:
The Willy Chavarria x adidas Woven Track Pant combines a distinctive wide-cut silhouette with characteristic details from the collaborative collection by Willy Chavarria and adidas. The deep black base gives the track pants a clean and versatile appearance, while dark red adidas 3-Stripes running along the outer sides create a contrasting accent. On the front, a white rose graphic and two vertically positioned white Trefoil logos complete the design and create a distinctive look. The elastic waistband emphasizes the sporty character of the black adidas track pants and, together with the generous cut, provides a relaxed fit. Elasticated leg openings also reference classic track pant design and subtly shape the wide silhouette at the hem. Combining Black, deep dark red and crisp white details, the Willy Chavarria x adidas pants appear both minimalist and expressive. The woven fabric completes the functionally inspired design and makes the Woven Track Pant a versatile choice for modern casual outfits and individual combinations with other pieces from the adidas collection.

products.title: Gallery Shoe
products.body_html:
The Crocs Gallery Shoe in the Bark colorway combines a distinctive, sculptural silhouette with the uncomplicated comfort associated with Crocs design. Visually reminiscent of a modern moccasin or boat shoe, the model combines an open toe with classic lacing and a bold, voluminous sole. The upper comes in a warm, light Bark shade positioned between sandy brown, beige and natural taupe. Its noticeably textured, slightly rough surface creates additional depth and gives the shoe a craft-inspired character. The substantial sole contrasts with the upper in a muted khaki beige and is accentuated by a finely dotted texture and lateral cut-outs. Tonal laces and subtle Crocs branding details consistently continue the understated color scheme. The raised sole edge protects large areas of the upper while reinforcing the shoe’s unconventional shape. A pronounced tread emphasizes the functional character of the Crocs Gallery Shoe. By combining an earthy color palette, textured surface and progressive chunky sole, the design creates a versatile casual shoe that brings traditional footwear references together with an experimental, contemporary Crocs aesthetic.

• Color: Bark in sandy brown, beige and natural taupe shades

• Textured, rough-finish upper with tonal lacing

• Open toe with a moccasin and boat shoe-inspired design

• Voluminous, treaded sole in muted khaki beige

• Article number: 210640-0IP

products.title: Classic EXP
products.body_html:
The Crocs Classic EXP in Koi Fish reinterprets the unmistakable clog silhouette with a functional, progressive design. Its defining feature is the almost monochromatic colorway in a bold, warm orange that extends across the upper, heel strap and voluminous sole construction. The intense Koi Fish shade emphasizes the sculpted shape and gives the model a particularly expressive look. Signature ventilation holes in the forefoot promote airflow while also offering options for individual customization with Jibbitz charms. The lightweight, molded upper supports effortless comfort, while the movable heel strap can be worn forward or behind the heel depending on your preferred styling. Another distinctive feature is the more substantial sole unit, giving the Crocs Classic EXP a robust, technical aesthetic. For additional traction, the model features a Vibram outsole with a grippy tread structure that consistently complements its functional concept. The Crocs Classic EXP combines characteristic Crocs DNA with distinctive design language, bold orange coloring and a sole construction developed for everyday versatility.

• Color: Koi Fish in bold, almost monochromatic orange

• Lightweight molded clog construction with ventilation holes

• Movable heel strap for different wearing options

• Textured Vibram outsole for additional grip

• Article number: 212793-85H

products.title: Echo II Chrome
products.body_html:
The Crocs Echo II Clog in Silver Chrome combines the progressive design language of the Echo Collection with functional comfort and a technical aesthetic. Its distinctive silhouette is characterized by flowing contours, numerous ventilation openings and a voluminously sculpted sole construction. The Silver Chrome colorway appears predominantly in dark anthracite and graphite grey, giving the clog an understated, futuristic appearance. Muted light grey to slightly olive-toned sections in the footbed and within the lateral sole cut-outs create subtle contrasts. A particularly striking feature is the textile backstrap with silver-colored, reflective-looking chevron details, emphasizing the technical character while allowing for an adjustable fit. The molded Croslite™ construction keeps the Crocs clog pleasantly lightweight, while generous openings promote ventilation. A soft LiteRide™ footbed provides comfortable cushioning during longer walks and everyday wear. The heavily textured outsole continues the organic lines of the upper while providing reliable ground contact. Combining distinctive design, practical functionality and the brand’s characteristic comfort, the Crocs Echo II Clog offers a contemporary interpretation of the classic clog silhouette.

• Color: Silver Chrome with anthracite, graphite and silver-grey details

• Lightweight Croslite™ construction with generous ventilation openings

• Soft LiteRide™ footbed for comfortable cushioning

• Adjustable backstrap with reflective-looking chevron details

• Article number: 213780-1ZY

products.title: Classic EXP
products.body_html:
The Crocs Classic EXP reinterprets the familiar clog silhouette with a more technical, robust construction, combining the characteristic Crocs look with functional details for everyday wear. The Black colorway consistently features deep black across the structured upper, adjustable heel strap and voluminous sole construction. Different surface textures create subtle contrasts despite the monochrome design. Multiple ventilation holes across the upper as well as larger openings along the sides define the functional appearance and promote airflow. The movable heel strap offers flexible wearing options and provides additional support when required. The substantial midsole construction is particularly distinctive, giving the Crocs Classic EXP a progressive, outdoor-inspired character. Underfoot, a textured Vibram outsole completes the construction and is designed for reliable traction and durability. The small yellow Vibram logo on the lateral side provides the only prominent color contrast against the black design. With its generously shaped toe area, effortless slip-on construction and functional sole, the black Crocs Classic EXP consistently evolves the classic clog DNA.

• Color: Black with a monochrome black finish

products.body_html:
The adidas Arsenal FC Tee SPZL F.C. brings the rich heritage of Arsenal London together with the iconic aesthetic of the Spezial range in a striking jersey-inspired t-shirt. Bright accents in Collegiate Gold stand out along the shoulders via signature three stripes and thin piping lines. The two-tone V-neck collar pairs dark navy with a vivid red inner insert for a dynamic finish. Front details feature a bold white SPZL chest graphic, an embroidered red Arsenal cannon crest, and a rectangular adidas Spezial F.C. patch. The back is centered around a large circular white Spezial F.C. emblem. Designed with a comfortable regular fit, this short-sleeve top combines authentic football culture with sophisticated everyday style.

products.title: Trucker Cap
products.body_html:
This classic cap by Molotow presents itself in a timeless, deep black shade that fully covers the structured front panel, curved visor, and rear mesh insert. products.title: D.D. Shell Hooded Puffer Jacket
products.body_html:
With the C.P. Company D.D. Shell Hooded Puffer Jacket, you rely on a highly functional down jacket that impresses with thoughtful details and excellent weather protection. Crafted from ultra-lightweight 7-denier nylon micro-ripstop, the windproof outer fabric reliably shields against moisture thanks to a special anti-drop treatment. Direct down injection ensures optimal thermal insulation while maintaining a surprisingly low weight. products.title: ZX 8094 "The Missing Link"
products.body_html:
RELEASE INFORMATION:

WHAT: Overkill x adidas Consortium ZX 8094 “The Missing Link”
SIZES: 35 1/2 - 49 1/3
WHEN: 26.09.2026 - 11:00 AM - In-Store First
WHERE: Overkill Berlin - Köpenicker Str. 195 A - 10997 Berlin & Overkill Cologne - Hahnenstr. 20 - 50667 Cologne
ONLINE (REMAINING PAIRS): 27.09.2026 - 04:00 PM

With the adidas ZX 8094 Overkill, OVERKILL and adidas Consortium are introducing a completely new silhouette as part of “The Missing Link” pack—and the answer to a question that was never actually asked: What would a ZX have looked like if the design worlds of ZX and Equipment had merged in 1994?

The ZX 8094 brings together two of the most influential adidas franchises of the early ’90s in a single shoe. Its foundation comes from the four-digit ZX series: the tooling and the characteristic stitched heel counter draw on elements of the iconic ZX 8000. This is balanced by key design elements from the EQT Support 91. The TPU cage, upper, and materials are inspired by the Equipment silhouette, making the ZX 8094 a true hybrid of two distinct adidas design languages.

The colorway also bridges the gap between these two worlds. A subdued base is accented with the unmistakable EQT green—a color that epitomizes the Equipment era like no other and is featured, among other places, on the Three Stripes.

The ZX 8094 is rounded out by special OVERKILL branding on the heel, insole, tongue label, and Torsion bar. Two additional pairs of laces and another pair of co-branded lace tags offer further opportunities for customization.

The adidas ZX 8094 Overkill is thus not a retro reissue of a forgotten model, but a new design built from familiar elements—a missing link between ZX and EQT, the past, and an alternative version of what could have emerged in 1994.

With the adidas ZX 8000 Overkill, one of the most iconic classics from the adidas archive meets the design language of the Equipment era. As one half of the OVERKILL x adidas “The Missing Link” pack, the ZX 8000 serves as the familiar counterpart to the completely redesigned ZX 8094.

While the construction remains true to the iconic ZX silhouette, the shoe adopts the color scheme of its hybrid partner. A subdued base is complemented by details in the signature EQT green. The connection is particularly evident on the three stripes, which carry the Equipment influence over to the classic ZX 8000. Distinctive Torsion design elements add further accents.

The result is a ZX 8000 that doesn’t alter its heritage but rather reinterprets it from a different perspective. While the ZX 8094 fuses ZX and EQT elements in its design, the ZX 8000 demonstrates how the aesthetics of the Equipment era work within a classic ZX silhouette.

Special OVERKILL branding on the heel, insole, tongue label, and Torsion bar highlights the collaborative nature of the design. The shoe also comes with two additional pairs of laces and an extra pair of co-branded lace tags.

The adidas ZX 8000 Overkill thus combines one of the most iconic ZX silhouettes with the visual DNA of EQT—and, together with the ZX 8094, serves as the link between two defining chapters in adidas history.
